title: Sheafification commutes with localized open-site transport
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and U an open. Write E for Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U, P for precomposition of presheaves of modules with the inverse equivalence of open sites, a for module sheafification on the localized site, and b for module sheafification on U.toScheme [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Coefficients on the localized site are the structure sheaf restricted over U; coefficients on U.toScheme are its structure sheaf. There is a natural isomorphism a followed by E ≅ P followed by b. This concerns all presheaves of modules and involves no tensor product.

source.place: Sheafification step in the localized-open-site construction; proof details supplied by W4 using the universal property of sheafification and uniqueness of left adjoints

proof.text: Construct the presheaf transport adjunction from Mathlib SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardAdj: endow the two ring presheaves with the bottom Grothendieck topologies. Every presheaf is a sheaf for these topologies, so lifting module presheaves into module sheaves is fully faithful. Both pushforward squares commute definitionally. Restrict the sheaf transport adjunction along these lifts using Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful. This is a proved private construction, with no choice of arbitrary witnesses.

Use the inverse open-site equivalence and the coefficient isomorphisms overPullbackSheafEquivOver and sheafRestrictSheafEquivOver. The first coefficient compatibility is reflexive; the second follows by the explicit unit and counit formulas of the open-site equivalence. Apply the presheaf transport adjunction from the preceding step. Its forward functor is definitionally the displayed pushforward of commutative-ring module presheaves.

Compose the localized module sheafification adjunction with Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U.toAdjunction. Compose the presheaf transport adjunction with module sheafification on U.toScheme. Their right adjoints agree definitionally, since forgetting a transported sheaf is transporting its underlying presheaf. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq supplies the required natural isomorphism, and hence Nonempty. No tensor argument or new unproved lemma is used.

proof_origin.place: Sheafification-transport step; original W4 universal-property argument implemented using Mathlib pushforwardPushforwardAdj on bottom topologies, restrictFullyFaithful, and leftAdjointUniq.

from.place: Proper-flat support argument: derived tensor of local perfect models; module-tensor portion of localized open restriction, step 1 of lem-sc-localized-open-kflat-tensor-restriction; sheafification compatibility with the equivalence of localized open sites

lean.statement:
theorem exists_localizedOpen_sheafification_iso (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) :
    Nonempty (
      PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u}
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)
          (𝟙 ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U).obj) ⋙
          (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor ≅
        PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
          (TopologicalSpace.Opens.overEquivalence U).inverse (X.sheaf.over U).obj ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u}
            (R₀ := (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).obj)
            (R := moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)
            (𝟙 (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).obj))
